name: Artificial Electronics Intelligent Material Limited
about: Artificial Electronics Intelligent Material Limited manufactures and sells semiconductors parts in India. It offers sapphire ingots and wafers, silicon carbide ingots and wafers, and silicon ingot and wafers. The company was formerly known as Datasoft Application Software (India) Limited and changed its name to Artificial Electronics Intelligent Material Limited in March 2024. Artificial Electronics Intelligent Material Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Oragadam, India.
